configurePresets.name: ninja-tooling
configurePresets.description: Emits compile_commands.json for clang-tidy/clangd. Run from an MSVC developer environment (vcvars64). Pass -DCUDAToolkit_ROOT=... to override the default toolkit path.

configurePresets.name: msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Multi-config Visual Studio generator. Does not emit compile_commands.json.

configurePresets.name: core-only
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja, protocol core + tests only (any OS)
configurePresets.description: CUDALINK_TOP_CORE_ONLY=ON: no CUDA toolkit, no TD headers, no TOP DLLs. Uses the default compiler (gcc/clang on Linux).
